sample.selection: Lowest fixed SHA256 of source candidate identity, before receipt localization; no validity labels read

limitations: A reported assertion-containing line can fail during operand evaluation; it does not prove the predicate itself was false.
Unique source location does not prove the first causal failure, concrete helper invocation, or dynamic receiver identity.
Matching assertion ASTs does not establish whole emitted/normalized setup or ancestor-control equivalence.
Lexical prefixes and proposed questions are not validated new tests or complete causal slices.
The source-size counts are not measured model-token savings or correctness improvements.
